description: List tasks, filterable by assignee, due-date range and completion, with cursor pagination. Excludes completed tasks by default and sorts open urgent tasks first (within the returned page), then due date ascending (undated first).

assignedToMemberId.description: Member id to filter by. Omit for all assignees.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous response. Omit for the first page.

dueDateOnOrAfter.description: Earliest due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Undated tasks never match.

dueDateOnOrBefore.description: Latest due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Undated tasks never match.

includeCompleted.description: Include completed tasks. Defaults to false.

name: list_tasks
